name: ALM Equity AB (publ)
summary: ALM Equity AB (publ) operates as a real estate development company in Sweden. The company operates through five business areas: Project Development Housing, Construction Management, Real Estate Management, Financing, and Digital Services. The Project Development Housing business area engages in acquiring, structuring, financing, conceptualizing, and developing housing projects under the ALM Bostad and Småa brands. The Construction Management business area plans, manages, and controls construction projects under the 2A Entreprenad brand. The Real Estate Management business area is involved in the ownership, management, and rental of homes and other premises for companies, authorities, and individuals under the Svenska Nyttobostäder brand. The Financing business area offers financing solutions for developers, managers, and investors in housing and real estate projects under the Nordisk Fastighetskredit brand. The Digital Services business area develops software and services to establish digital communities and sharing economics under the Your Block brand. ALM Equity AB (publ) was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
